LanguageData.CBF_Build_Profiles: Building wall profiles, towers and gatehouses
LanguageData.CBF_AllBuildableHelp: Gives every building that has no architect category of its own one, so you can place it from the architect menu instead of crafting and installing it. In Medieval Overhaul that is 258 things: rugs, statues, ruin pieces, hideout furniture. Things without build cost are skipped, they would be free. Takes effect after a restart.
LanguageData.CBF_AllBuildableRestart: Takes effect after restarting RimWorld. The architect menu is built once at startup.

LanguageData.CBF_ReserveGround: Reserve building ground before the rock
LanguageData.CBF_ReserveGroundHelp: Before RimWorld places the rock, the edge of the mountain recedes where the settlement will stand, and only far enough for it to fit. The shape of the mountain is kept, the rest of the map is untouched. Off means the settlement has to make do with the terrain as grown and can fail on rocky tiles.
LanguageData.CBF_OneConnectOnly: There already is a connection. The wall looks for exactly one anchor named Wall, and all its cells belong to that one area. Pick the existing one and paint onto it.
